Article 5
Sufficiently clear Letter a.
What is meant by "physical violence" is any act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, loss of consciousness and or causes death. Letter b.
What is meant by "sexual violence" is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, forced sexual intercourse in an unnatural or unwanted manner, forced sexual intercourse with others for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.
Letter c.
What is meant by "economic violence" is an action that restricts a person from working inside or outside the home to earn money and goods, including allowing a person who works to be exploited, while someone does not fulfill the economic needs of the family.
Letter d.
What is meant by "social violence" is an act of a person or group of people that causes injury or loss of life to a person or can cause physical damage or damage to another person's property Letter e.
What is meant by "psychological violence" is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and or severe psychological suffering to a person.
Letter f.
What is meant by "Household Neglect" is:
1. actions that result in the failure to fulfill the needs of children properly, whether physical, mental, spiritual or social;
2. actions of deliberately neglecting to maintain, care for, or take care of children as appropriate; 3. actions that neglect people within the household scope, whereas according to the law applicable to them or due to an agreement or contract they are obligated to provide livelihood, care, or maintenance to that person; 4. actions that result in economic dependence by restricting and/or prohibiting decent work inside or outside the home so that the victim is under the control of that person.
Letter g.
What is meant by "neglect of workers" is an action by any person or legal entity that results in improper treatment of female workers whereas according to the law applicable to them or due to an agreement or contract they are obligated to provide adequate protection from lawful actions against workers such as haphazard recruitment, unclear shelters and workplaces, arbitrary business owners.
Letter h.
What is meant by "coercion or deprivation" of freedom is:
1. Coercion is any act or action of taking, bringing, inviting a child or woman with persuasion and or coercion to be made a wife or to be employed illegally.
2. Deprivation of freedom is any act or action of taking, bringing, inviting, kidnapping a child or woman to be made a wife or employed by confining, detaining or imprisoning illegally in a room or certain place.
Letter i.
What is meant by "threat of certain actions" is any unlawful act in the form of speech, writing, images, symbols or body movements, whether with or without using means

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by: 1 Region is North Lampung Regency. Regional Government is the regional head as an element of the Regional Government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region. 2.
3.
Regent is the Regent of North Lampung
4.
Regional People's Representative Council abbreviated as DPRD is the DPRD of North Lampung Regency Regional Apparatus Organization is an auxiliary element of the regional head in the administration of Government Affairs that are the authority of the Region. Woman is a person who has the predicate as an adult girl, and or as a wife/mother, who is legally and naturally recognized as a woman. Child is someone who is not yet 18 (eighteen) years old, including a child still in the womb. 8. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband, wife, or husband and wife and their children, or father and children or mother and children, or blood relatives in a straight line upwards or downwards in the first degree. 9. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty.
10. Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or private life.
11. Violence against children is any action that results in or may result in suffering of children physically, sexually, economically, socially and psychologically.
12. Acts of violence are women and children who experience misery and or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
13. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutors, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will occur, is occurring or has occurred.
14. Child Protection is all activities to guarantee and protect Children and their rights so they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and dignity, and receive protection from violence and discrimination. 15. Special Protection is a form of protection received by Children in certain situations and conditions to obtain a guarantee of security against threats that endanger themselves and their lives in their growth and development. 16. Cooperation is an activity or effort carried out by several people to achieve common goals. 17. Forum for the Protection of Women and Children from Acts of Violence hereinafter abbreviated as FP2ATK is a forum established based on this Regional Regulation whose membership comes from relevant agencies and communities concerned with the empowerment of women and protection of children from acts of violence.
18. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will occur, is occurring or has occurred. 19. Companion is a social worker who has professional competence in their field. 20. Victim recovery is all efforts to strengthen victims of domestic violence to be more empowered, both physically and psychologically. 21. Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment hereinafter abbreviated as P2TPA is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment, Safe House, Children's Social Protection House, Trauma Center Protection House, Women's Social Protection House, Shelter House, or integrated service provider institutions for victims established by the Regional Government.

Letter e.
What is meant by "social rehabilitation services" is services aimed at restoring and developing the abilities of a person experiencing social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly. Letter f.

Letter g. What is meant by "repatriation and reintegration" is returning women and children who are victims of violence from the receiving area to the area of origin. This Regional Regulation.P J 8 does not conflict with

ELUCIDATION OF
REGIONAL REGULATION OF NORTH LAMPUNG REGENCY NUMBER 1 OF 2017
CONCERNING
PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN
FROM ACTS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL
Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in North Lampung Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades their degree and human dignity, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation to regulate protection efforts, therefore institutional support and regulations are needed that can guarantee its implementation, particularly in terms of prevention, services and empowerment for women and children victims of violence in Lampung Regency

Article 10
Sufficiently clear Paragraph (1) Letter a.
What is meant by "complaint services" is a series of actions carried out by integrated service providers to follow up on reports of acts of violence against women and children submitted by victims, families or the community Letter b. What is meant by "health services" is efforts that include promotive, preventive, curative and rehabilitative aspects. Letter c.
What is meant by "counseling" is a process of providing objective and complete information, carried out systematically with interpersonal communication guidance, guidance techniques and mastery of clinical knowledge aimed at helping a person recognize their current condition, the problems being faced, and determine solutions or efforts to overcome these problems Letter d. What is meant by "spiritual guidance" is a form of activity in which there is a process of spiritual guidance and development for humans so as to provide peace, tranquility and coolness of heart to humans by always providing encouragement and motivation to remain patient, trust in God and continue to carry out their obligations.
Letter e.
What is meant by "social rehabilitation services" is services aimed at restoring and developing the abilities of a person experiencing social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly. Letter f.
What is meant by "legal aid and assistance services" is legal services provided by legal assistants or advocates to carry out the process of accompanying witnesses and/or victims of violence against women and children that is gender sensitive.
Letter g. What is meant by "repatriation and reintegration" is returning women and children who are victims of violence from the receiving area to the area of origin. Paragraph (2) Letter a What is meant by "special service rooms" are hospitals and other places such as Resort Police Headquarters, Hospitals, designated hospitals and at offices/agencies or other places determined by the Regional Government. Letter b Sufficiently clear Letter c.
What is meant by "Service Center and Safe House" is what is known as trauma center, while safe house is known as shelter. Sufficiently clear Paragraph (3) Sufficiently clear Paragraph (4) Sufficiently clear Paragraph (5) Sufficiently clear Paragraph (6) Sufficiently clear

Article 5
Sufficiently clear Letter a.
What is meant by "physical violence" is any act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, loss of consciousness and or causes death. Letter b.
What is meant by "sexual violence" is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, forced sexual intercourse in an unnatural or unwanted manner, forced sexual intercourse with others for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.
Letter c.
What is meant by "economic violence" is an action that restricts a person from working inside or outside the home to earn money and goods, including allowing a person who works to be exploited, while someone does not fulfill the economic needs of the family.
Letter d.
What is meant by "social violence" is an act of a person or group of people that causes injury or loss of life to a person or can cause physical damage or damage to another person's property Letter e.
What is meant by "psychological violence" is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and or severe psychological suffering to a person.
Letter f.
What is meant by "Household Neglect" is:
1. actions that result in the failure to fulfill the needs of children properly, whether physical, mental, spiritual or social;
2. actions of deliberately neglecting to maintain, care for, or take care of children as appropriate; 3. actions that neglect people within the household scope, whereas according to the law applicable to them or due to an agreement or contract they are obligated to provide livelihood, care, or maintenance to that person; 4. actions that result in economic dependence by restricting and/or prohibiting decent work inside or outside the home so that the victim is under the control of that person.
Letter g.
What is meant by "neglect of workers" is an action by any person or legal entity that results in improper treatment of female workers whereas according to the law applicable to them or due to an agreement or contract they are obligated to provide adequate protection from lawful actions against workers such as haphazard recruitment, unclear shelters and workplaces, arbitrary business owners.
Letter h.
What is meant by "coercion or deprivation" of freedom is:
1. Coercion is any act or action of taking, bringing, inviting a child or woman with persuasion and or coercion to be made a wife or to be employed illegally.
2. Deprivation of freedom is any act or action of taking, bringing, inviting, kidnapping a child or woman to be made a wife or employed by confining, detaining or imprisoning illegally in a room or certain place.
Letter i.
What is meant by "threat of certain actions" is any unlawful act in the form of speech, writing, images, symbols or body movements, whether with or without using means

Article 25
(1) The Regional Government encourages the business sector to participate in the protection of women and children from acts of violence.
(2) Participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may take the form of:
a. socialization to employees within the company environment regarding the dangers of acts of violence against women and children; and
b. assistance as a form of corporate social responsibility.

CHAPTER III
SCOPE
Article 4
(1) The Scope of this Regional Regulation consists of a. protection of women; and b. protection of children.
(2) Protection of women as referred to in Article 4 letter a includes: a. prevention of acts of violence;
b. integrated services for victims of acts of violence; and c. empowerment of victims of acts of violence. (3) Protection of children as referred to in Article 4 letter b includes:
a. protection of children who are victims of acts of violence; and b. special protection of children.

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by: 1 Region is North Lampung Regency. Regional Government is the regional head as an element of the Regional Government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region. 2.
3.
Regent is the Regent of North Lampung
4.
Regional People's Representative Council abbreviated as DPRD is the DPRD of North Lampung Regency Regional Apparatus Organization is an auxiliary element of the regional head in the administration of Government Affairs that are the authority of the Region. Woman is a person who has the predicate as an adult girl, and or as a wife/mother, who is legally and naturally recognized as a woman. Child is someone who is not yet 18 (eighteen) years old, including a child still in the womb. 8. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband, wife, or husband and wife and their children, or father and children or mother and children, or blood relatives in a straight line upwards or downwards in the first degree. 9. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty.
10. Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or private life.
11. Violence against children is any action that results in or may result in suffering of children physically, sexually, economically, socially and psychologically.
12. Acts of violence are women and children who experience misery and or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
13. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutors, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will occur, is occurring or has occurred.
14. Child Protection is all activities to guarantee and protect Children and their rights so they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and dignity, and receive protection from violence and discrimination. 15. Special Protection is a form of protection received by Children in certain situations and conditions to obtain a guarantee of security against threats that endanger themselves and their lives in their growth and development. 16. Cooperation is an activity or effort carried out by several people to achieve common goals. 17. Forum for the Protection of Women and Children from Acts of Violence hereinafter abbreviated as FP2ATK is a forum established based on this Regional Regulation whose membership comes from relevant agencies and communities concerned with the empowerment of women and protection of children from acts of violence.
18. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will occur, is occurring or has occurred. 19. Companion is a social worker who has professional competence in their field. 20. Victim recovery is all efforts to strengthen victims of domestic violence to be more empowered, both physically and psychologically. 21. Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment hereinafter abbreviated as P2TPA is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment, Safe House, Children's Social Protection House, Trauma Center Protection House, Women's Social Protection House, Shelter House, or integrated service provider institutions for victims established by the Regional Government.

Letter c.

Letter d.

Letter f.

1. actions that result in the failure to fulfill the needs of children properly, whether physical, mental, spiritual or social;

Letter g.
What is meant by "neglect of workers" is an action by any person or legal entity that results in improper treatment of female workers whereas according to the law applicable to them or due to an agreement or contract they are obligated to provide adequate protection from lawful actions against workers such as haphazard recruitment, unclear shelters and workplaces, arbitrary business owners.
Letter h.
What is meant by "coercion or deprivation" of freedom is:
1. Coercion is any act or action of taking, bringing, inviting a child or woman with persuasion and or coercion to be made a wife or to be employed illegally.
2. Deprivation of freedom is any act or action of taking, bringing, inviting, kidnapping a child or woman to be made a wife or employed by confining, detaining or imprisoning illegally in a room or certain place.
Letter i.
What is meant by "threat of certain actions" is any unlawful act in the form of speech, writing, images, symbols or body movements, whether with or without using means

ELUCIDATION OF
REGIONAL REGULATION OF NORTH LAMPUNG REGENCY NUMBER 1 OF 2017
CONCERNING
PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN
FROM ACTS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL
Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in North Lampung Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades their degree and human dignity, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation to regulate protection efforts, therefore institutional support and regulations are needed that can guarantee its implementation, particularly in terms of prevention, services and empowerment for women and children victims of violence in Lampung Regency

ELUCIDATION OF
REGIONAL REGULATION OF NORTH LAMPUNG REGENCY NUMBER 1 OF 2017
CONCERNING
PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN
FROM ACTS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL
Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in North Lampung Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades their degree and human dignity, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation to regulate protection efforts, therefore institutional support and regulations are needed that can guarantee its implementation, particularly in terms of prevention, services and empowerment for women and children victims of violence in Lampung Regency

ELUCIDATION OF
REGIONAL REGULATION OF NORTH LAMPUNG REGENCY NUMBER 1 OF 2017
CONCERNING
PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN
FROM ACTS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL
Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in North Lampung Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades their degree and human dignity, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation to regulate protection efforts, therefore institutional support and regulations are needed that can guarantee its implementation, particularly in terms of prevention, services and empowerment for women and children victims of violence in Lampung Regency

CHAPTER IV
IMPLEMENTATION
OF WOMEN'S PROTECTION
Part One
General

Article 5
Sufficiently clear Letter a.
What is meant by "physical violence" is any act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, loss of consciousness and or causes death. Letter b.
What is meant by "sexual violence" is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, forced sexual intercourse in an unnatural or unwanted manner, forced sexual intercourse with others for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.
Letter c.
What is meant by "economic violence" is an action that restricts a person from working inside or outside the home to earn money and goods, including allowing a person who works to be exploited, while someone does not fulfill the economic needs of the family.
Letter d.
What is meant by "social violence" is an act of a person or group of people that causes injury or loss of life to a person or can cause physical damage or damage to another person's property Letter e.
What is meant by "psychological violence" is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and or severe psychological suffering to a person.
Letter f.
What is meant by "Household Neglect" is:
1. actions that result in the failure to fulfill the needs of children properly, whether physical, mental, spiritual or social;
2. actions of deliberately neglecting to maintain, care for, or take care of children as appropriate; 3. actions that neglect people within the household scope, whereas according to the law applicable to them or due to an agreement or contract they are obligated to provide livelihood, care, or maintenance to that person; 4. actions that result in economic dependence by restricting and/or prohibiting decent work inside or outside the home so that the victim is under the control of that person.
Letter g.
What is meant by "neglect of workers" is an action by any person or legal entity that results in improper treatment of female workers whereas according to the law applicable to them or due to an agreement or contract they are obligated to provide adequate protection from lawful actions against workers such as haphazard recruitment, unclear shelters and workplaces, arbitrary business owners.
Letter h.
What is meant by "coercion or deprivation" of freedom is:
1. Coercion is any act or action of taking, bringing, inviting a child or woman with persuasion and or coercion to be made a wife or to be employed illegally.
2. Deprivation of freedom is any act or action of taking, bringing, inviting, kidnapping a child or woman to be made a wife or employed by confining, detaining or imprisoning illegally in a room or certain place.
Letter i.
What is meant by "threat of certain actions" is any unlawful act in the form of speech, writing, images, symbols or body movements, whether with or without using means

Second Part
Institutional Framework for the Protection of Women and Children

Article 14
Paragraph (1) Letter o.
What is meant by "stigmatization" is the giving of a mark or stigma to a person, or a group of people with a certain meaningful understanding in a certain situation and context, openly or covertly, to influence the thinking power or evaluative power of a person or a group

CHAPTER III
SCOPE
Article 4
(1) The Scope of this Regional Regulation consists of a. protection of women; and b. protection of children.
(2) Protection of women as referred to in Article 4 letter a includes: a. prevention of acts of violence;
b. integrated services for victims of acts of violence; and c. empowerment of victims of acts of violence. (3) Protection of children as referred to in Article 4 letter b includes:
a. protection of children who are victims of acts of violence; and b. special protection of children.

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by: 1 Region is North Lampung Regency. Regional Government is the regional head as an element of the Regional Government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region. 2.
3.
Regent is the Regent of North Lampung
4.
Regional People's Representative Council abbreviated as DPRD is the DPRD of North Lampung Regency Regional Apparatus Organization is an auxiliary element of the regional head in the administration of Government Affairs that are the authority of the Region. Woman is a person who has the predicate as an adult girl, and or as a wife/mother, who is legally and naturally recognized as a woman. Child is someone who is not yet 18 (eighteen) years old, including a child still in the womb. 8. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband, wife, or husband and wife and their children, or father and children or mother and children, or blood relatives in a straight line upwards or downwards in the first degree. 9. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or unlawful deprivation of liberty.
10. Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or private life.
11. Violence against children is any action that results in or may result in suffering of children physically, sexually, economically, socially and psychologically.
12. Acts of violence are women and children who experience misery and or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
13. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutors, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will occur, is occurring or has occurred.
14. Child Protection is all activities to guarantee and protect Children and their rights so they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and dignity, and receive protection from violence and discrimination. 15. Special Protection is a form of protection received by Children in certain situations and conditions to obtain a guarantee of security against threats that endanger themselves and their lives in their growth and development. 16. Cooperation is an activity or effort carried out by several people to achieve common goals. 17. Forum for the Protection of Women and Children from Acts of Violence hereinafter abbreviated as FP2ATK is a forum established based on this Regional Regulation whose membership comes from relevant agencies and communities concerned with the empowerment of women and protection of children from acts of violence.
18. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will occur, is occurring or has occurred. 19. Companion is a social worker who has professional competence in their field. 20. Victim recovery is all efforts to strengthen victims of domestic violence to be more empowered, both physically and psychologically. 21. Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment hereinafter abbreviated as P2TPA is a generic term that can be used by various institutions that provide services for victims of violence such as Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment, Safe House, Children's Social Protection House, Trauma Center Protection House, Women's Social Protection House, Shelter House, or integrated service provider institutions for victims established by the Regional Government.

Article 10
Sufficiently clear Paragraph (1) Letter a.
What is meant by "complaint services" is a series of actions carried out by integrated service providers to follow up on reports of acts of violence against women and children submitted by victims, families or the community Letter b. What is meant by "health services" is efforts that include promotive, preventive, curative and rehabilitative aspects. Letter c.
What is meant by "counseling" is a process of providing objective and complete information, carried out systematically with interpersonal communication guidance, guidance techniques and mastery of clinical knowledge aimed at helping a person recognize their current condition, the problems being faced, and determine solutions or efforts to overcome these problems Letter d. What is meant by "spiritual guidance" is a form of activity in which there is a process of spiritual guidance and development for humans so as to provide peace, tranquility and coolness of heart to humans by always providing encouragement and motivation to remain patient, trust in God and continue to carry out their obligations.
Letter e.
What is meant by "social rehabilitation services" is services aimed at restoring and developing the abilities of a person experiencing social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly. Letter f.
What is meant by "legal aid and assistance services" is legal services provided by legal assistants or advocates to carry out the process of accompanying witnesses and/or victims of violence against women and children that is gender sensitive.
Letter g. What is meant by "repatriation and reintegration" is returning women and children who are victims of violence from the receiving area to the area of origin. Paragraph (2) Letter a What is meant by "special service rooms" are hospitals and other places such as Resort Police Headquarters, Hospitals, designated hospitals and at offices/agencies or other places determined by the Regional Government. Letter b Sufficiently clear Letter c.
What is meant by "Service Center and Safe House" is what is known as trauma center, while safe house is known as shelter. Sufficiently clear Paragraph (3) Sufficiently clear Paragraph (4) Sufficiently clear Paragraph (5) Sufficiently clear Paragraph (6) Sufficiently clear

CONCERNING

I. GENERAL
Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination. In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in North Lampung Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades their degree and human dignity, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation to regulate protection efforts, therefore institutional support and regulations are needed that can guarantee its implementation, particularly in terms of prevention, services and empowerment for women and children victims of violence in Lampung Regency

SCOPE
Article 4
(1) The Scope of this Regional Regulation consists of a. protection of women; and b. protection of children.

b. integrated services for victims of acts of violence; and c. empowerment of victims of acts of violence. (3) Protection of children as referred to in Article 4 letter b includes:
a. protection of children who are victims of acts of violence; and b. special protection of children.

Letter c.

Letter d.

Letter g.

Letter h.
